_readme: Every video call in the game, keyed by the id the code asks for:
PhoneCall.play_from_data(self, "ellie_intro")
Fields. Only `character`, `clothes` and `lines` are required. Art is in
Image_Assets/Character_Sprites/Talking_Sprites/.
speaker      name on the message box / the pill over the picture
screen_name  overrides the pill's text; "" hides the pill
character    folder under Characters/, e.g. "Ellie". The caller is built from PARTS on one
shared canvas, front to back: Hair/<C>_Hair_Front, Mouths/<C>_Mouth_1/_2/_3 (the
only animated part), Face/<C>_Face, Clothes/<C>_<clothes>, Hair/<C>_Hair_Back.
clothes      the outfit: "Dress" loads Clothes/Ellie_Dress.png. Swap this alone to put the
character in a new outfit - every face, mouth and expression carries over.
background   what is behind them, from Backgrounds/
phone        the handset art, from Phones/. Defaults to iPhone4.
colour       message_colour key, exactly as an NPC carries in All_NPC_Constant_Data.json
auto_advance true = timed lines and no player input, for a call that plays over a cutscene.
Leave it out for an ordinary call the player clicks through.
lines        what they say, one message box per entry
EXPRESSIONS. A line may open with an emotion tag in CAPITALS, and it applies to that line only:
"[HAPPY]Oh hey! So you're just coming round the corner then?"
The next line with no tag goes back to the neutral face. EVERY part is looked up on its own with
the emotion added, and falls back to its neutral art: [SAD] finds Ellie_Face_Sad and
Ellie_Mouth_Sad_1/_2/_3; [WINK] finds only Ellie_Face_Wink and talks with the normal mouth. Sad
clothes or hair would be Ellie_Dress_Sad / Ellie_Hair_Front_Sad. Casing is forgiving, and missing
art is a warning plus the neutral face rather than a broken call. [TIME], [NAME] and bbcode such as
[center] are NOT expressions and pass through untouched.
A new call is an entry here. A character calling in a different outfit, from a different place,
or at a different point in the story is a new entry - no code.

ellie_intro.speaker: Ellie
lines: Oh hey! So you're just coming round the corner now then?
[WINK] I knew you'd be late, I don't think you've ever been early.
I'll see you drive right on by in a sec! The movers did a good job getting all your stuff in fine, they've finished and the truck's just left now
You timed your move well, today's the first day it's been sunny this week
[SAD] You know how depressing the harbour gets when it's cold and rainy like that
[SAD] Even the forest is closed for now while they clear up the trees. And on a long bank holiday weekend too, there's nothing to do until the weekend is over now.
Well anyway, I'll let you drop your stuff off first and get settled in at least a little bit before I come to bug you.
[WINK] I'll drop by in a bit, see you soon!

_fish_shop_readme: FISH milestone calls: fish_shop_<N>_olly / fish_shop_<N>_alexander, rung by FishShopCalls the
moment the player has SENT N fish to FISH. Whoever is behind the counter today rings (the other
keeper's call is the fallback). N = every Interior_<N> in the two Fish Shop scenes, plus
FishShopCalls.CALL_ONLY (10, 200) and ITEM_UNLOCKS (50 permit, 200 Gold Rod). A line that is
exactly "[UNLOCK]" is where the item reveal plays; with none it plays after the last line.
The Olly/Alexander talking-head art does not exist yet -- the calls play with an empty screen.

fish_shop_10_olly.speaker: Olly
lines: Hey [NAME]! You've already sent me back almost a dozen fish, it was looking a bit empty in here before.
Thanks again for helping me with this! You could definitely use some new FISH gear, come and see me at the shop!

fish_shop_10_alexander.speaker: Alexander
lines: Hey [NAME], you've been busy recently I see, these tanks were practically empty before you started helping out.
Olly is already starting to clear out the basement to make room for more down there.

fish_shop_25_olly.speaker: Olly
lines: Hey [NAME]! That's 25 fish you've sent back to FISH!
Research is going great thanks to you, the fish just keep flying on in!
I've opened up the back of the shop and put a load of new tanks in, so you can send me more of each fish now!
Thanks again for all your hard work fishing, I've not had that much time with research to actually fish!

fish_shop_25_alexander.speaker: Alexander
lines: Hey [NAME], 25 fish sent back already... you're keeping us in business.
We've had to put a whole load of new tanks in out back, so you can send us more of each fish now.
But thanks to you I have to clean out all these tanks every day now... I need a raise...

fish_shop_50_olly.speaker: Olly
lines: Hey [NAME]! 50 fish! I can't believe how fast the shop is filling up!
I've rebuilt the tanks downstairs too, so there's room for more of every fish from the forest now.
Oh, and we've found an amazing fishing spot a few miles out of the harbour right in the middle of the ocean.
We've started offering trips out there a couple of times a day if you're interested in going to fish up some rare Pokemon!
[UNLOCK]
Just make sure you buy the permit to get there then show it to the boat captain at our fishing dock and he'll take you any time you want!
You'll only need to buy the permit once and we'll take you out there whenever you want, free of charge!

fish_shop_50_alexander.speaker: Alexander
lines: Hey [NAME], that's 50 fish sent back. Olly's had me rebuilding the tanks downstairs all week, so there's more room for the forest fish now.
Did Olly tell you about the new fishing spot we found out in the middle of the ocean?
[UNLOCK]
If you buy the permit from us then all you have to do is show it to the captain on our fishing dock and he'll sail you out.
He'll take you for free at any point you want to go and you might find some rare Pokemon so it's worth checking out.

fish_shop_75_olly.speaker: Olly
lines: Hey [NAME]! 75 fish sent back to FISH, you're unstoppable!
So many people are coming in just to see the tanks that I've opened up even more of the shop.
Come and have a look next time you're passing, it's really starting to look like a proper aquarium!

fish_shop_75_alexander.speaker: Alexander
lines: Hey [NAME], 75 fish. People are coming in just to look at the tanks now...
So naturally I've been the one putting up even more shelves. Come and see it next time you're in.

fish_shop_100_olly.speaker: Olly
lines: Hey [NAME]! You've done it, 100 fish sent back to FISH!
This is the best thing that's ever happened to the shop. I'm rebuilding the whole thing, upstairs and downstairs, bigger than ever!
There'll be room for way more of every fish now, so keep them coming!

fish_shop_100_alexander.speaker: Alexander
lines: Hey [NAME]... 100 fish. Olly's lost it, we're rebuilding the whole shop. Upstairs AND downstairs.
Bigger tanks and more room for every fish you can catch. Which means even more tanks for me to clean.
...Honestly though, thanks. The place has never looked better.

fish_shop_200_olly.speaker: Olly
lines: Hey [NAME]! 200 fish! I've never seen such a dedicated true to heart fisher.
I've got a special rod just for you and nobody else.
[UNLOCK]
It might cost you half an arm or a leg but you won't get any better than the Gold Rod!

fish_shop_200_alexander.speaker: Alexander
lines: Hey [NAME], 200 fish sent back. Our best customer by miles.
I've been told that you might be interested in our new Gold Rod.
[UNLOCK]
It's honestly the best rod I think has ever existed and makes fishing a breeze. It's just a bit pricey but we've got it if you want it.
